limitations: Read-only audit; no Linux binary was executed locally and no Cargo build was run by the auditor.
This is one fixed 4,096-record Linux x86_64 hosted run, not a whole-application or general runtime performance claim.
It verifies the archived protocol and evidence; it does not establish broader workload representativeness.

protocol.cross_arm_oracle: fixture bytes/hash, frozen configuration, source/graph/harness hashes, and all full exact payload/order/metadata identity oracles must match; only scheduler-assigned global sequence numbers and absolute per-attempt paths are normalized away after within-run sequence validation
protocol.metric: median of three raw GraphSession wall durations per invocation; paired candidate minus baseline; positive is slower
protocol.pair_order: alternating AB/BA across three warmup pairs and 48 measured pairs; first measured pair is BA
protocol.retry_policy: no retries; run both sides of the current pair, then stop after any failed pair and record all remaining planned slots as not attempted

timer_boundary_source_review: The pinned Rust harness captures Instant before GraphSession::start and immediately after run_to_completion; verify_outputs and event checks follow the timer.

workload_oracle.raw_validation: Each sample passed the separate frozen oracle validator: exact fixture bytes, full ordered input/output identities, equal fanout sequences, payload hashes, generation/revision/metadata checks, natural EOF/status accounting, 8193 terminal events, and zero dropped messages.
